analysis.summary: Decompiled replay_stairs walks fixed-stride records, schedules commands, collects indices, reverses them, removes records by tail compaction, and drops per-tag payloads. Early return occurs when puVar33[3] is zero; a param1 write precedes it. Two separate lookups supply distinct payload fields.

observations.claim: Observed: before the early-return test, the function writes *(u32*)param_1[2] from offset 0x1c of param_1 and reads a float from puVar33+5.
Observed: the outer record walk advances by 0x30 and processes only records whose first byte is '\n'; non-'\n' records are skipped without collection or output.
Observed: two distinct lookups exist: FUN_140a1c930(uVar6, cmd+4) produces puVar31 payload, while FUN_1405b0ed0(plVar24,&uStack_a0) probes a table and produces separate uStack_a0/uStack_fd fields.
Inferred: collected indices are reversed in place, then used high-to-low so each tail memmove preserves lower unprocessed indices.

advance to next 0x30 record; no index collection and no output record write.

branch_matrix.effect: uVar67/uVar68 payload become zero; otherwise copied from *puVar31 low/high 32 bits.

side_effects.effect: Write *(u32*)param_1[2] = *(u32*)((longlong)param_1+0x1c); load fVar3 from puVar33+5. If puVar33[3]==0, return before any later phases.
For each processed '\n' record, append record index uVar38 into temp buffer at puStack_c8[uVar28]; if count==capacity call FUN_140b81df0(&uStack_d0,&UNK_...).
For +8 flag != 0 path, if ordered record+0x18 <= scheduled fVar17, add *(float*)(lVar34+0x28) to record+0x18 and continue without emitting.

For emitted records, call helper(s) according to cmd[0x1c] and target 77bd/782f. Final record tag formulas: 77bd -> cmd[0x1c]+0x11; 782f -> (0x12-cmd[0x1c])+0x11. Add time at L351 only in the +8 flag !=0 emitted path.

First lookup FUN_140a1c930(uVar6, cmd+4) supplies puVar31 payload or null; separately second lookup FUN_1405b0ed0(plVar24,&uStack_a0) probes table and supplies uStack_a0/uStack_fd only when found, else zeros.

Write output record at base lVar8+0x28, index lVar35, stride 0x38: +0=*(lVar8+0x40); +8=final tag; +9..+0x27 assembled stack bytes; +0x28=CONCAT44(uVar67,uVar68) where zero if puVar31 null; +0x30=1. Then increment lVar8+0x30 and lVar8+0x40.
If collected count >1, reverse index array in place by swapping halves; no comparison sort observed.
Iterate reversed indices; bounds-check each, copy out 0x30 record, call func_0x142923c10(lVar37+lVar34, lVar37+lVar34+0x30, (~uVar41+uVar28)*0x30), then write *(lVar25+0x10)=uVar28-1.
Per removed record byte, switch drops payload variants; then if plStack_b0 != 0 call func_0x140613c20(puStack_b8, plStack_b0<<3, 8) to release temp buffer.

integration_checks: Verify the param1[2] write at L116 still occurs even when puVar33[3]==0 causes the L119 return.
Verify both record+8 bit0 paths are retained and that the nested +0x10->+0x10 bit selects 77bd vs 782f with the correct time-add placement.
Verify final record tag formulas are exactly cmd[0x1c]+0x11 for 77bd and (0x12-cmd[0x1c])+0x11 for 782f.
Verify the first lookup payload and second lookup payload remain separate when constructing the output record, and removal uses reversed collected indices with tail memmove and per-tag drop.
